summary:
Fixed and verified.

**The needle** was in `app/app.py`, in the pagination offset calculation:

```python
offset = (page - 1) * per_page - (1 if page > 1 else 0)   # buggy
offset = (page - 1) * per_page                             # fixed
```

The spurious `- (1 if page > 1 else 0)` shifted the offset back by one on every page after the first, causing the last item of each page to reappear as the first item of the next (page 1 ended at ID 10, page 2 started at ID 10 instead of 11). Removing it makes pages tile cleanly with no gap or overlap. `test.sh` now passes.
